description: This file contains server-side logic for a Theory Exam page in an online examination system. It manages loading questions from a database, handling user responses, timing the exam, and submitting answers to the database.

classes.name: TheoryExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the online theory exam page, managing question loading, timing, and answer submission.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page load event, loads questions from database based on session data, initializes timer.

methods.name: getCourseName
methods.description: Returns course name based on course ID.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Stores user's answers and updates relevant database tables upon submission.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out user and redirects to login page.

methods.name: Timer1_Tick
methods.description: Updates remaining time display and handles timeout.
